The original JAMO production system since 2013 does not establish that this separate v2 source is deployed. The project is newly created in July 2026; its public docs link redirects to a GitLab sign-in, and no current public user/install guide or independent use evidence was established. Hold until this version is production or has public operational-use/notability evidence and accessible user documentation.
